description: Baseline run on autoresearch branch (fast benchmark). summary_total=1136.6ms.
Baseline re-run #3. summary_total improved significantly (sync_barrier was low). Noise floor is high.
Parallel block reads for large files. lg_read=26.4ms (vs 24.7), sm_read=37.1 (vs 35.1). No improvement - disk I/O is bottleneck, not CPU.

asi.hypothesis: Parallelizing block reads with rayon would overlap I/O and decompression
asi.result: No improvement. Benchmark data is uncompressible random noise (CODEC_RAW), so decompression is memcpy. Disk I/O on single pack file is bottleneck that can't be parallelized. Parallel approach adds scheduling overhead without benefit.
asi.next_action_hint: Try reducing metadata overhead or optimizing the pack read path instead.

description: Combined header+payload read in pack.rs (single read_exact_at instead of two). No measurable change - syscall overhead is negligible for 1MB block reads.

asi.hypothesis: Combining two pread syscalls (header 41B + payload ~1MB) into one would reduce syscall overhead
asi.result: No measurable improvement. Syscall overhead is dwarfed by 1MB data read time.
asi.next_action_hint: Need a fundamentally different approach. Consider reducing read amplification (small files read full 1MB blocks for tiny data) or investigating the meta store transaction overhead.

description: Populate chunk_data_cache during writes. sm_read: 17.5ms (-50% vs 35.1). lg_read: 17.9ms (-26% vs 24.3). sm_write_dura increased from 144 to 171ms due to extra clone.

asi.hypothesis: Populating chunk_data_cache during writes would eliminate pack reads + decompression + CRC32 on first read
asi.result: Great improvement: sm_read -50%, lg_read -26%. But sm_write_dura increased ~19% due to extra Vec clone (clone in stage_chunk_if_missing + clone for cache = 2 clones per block). Need to eliminate the double clone.
asi.next_action_hint: Move cache insertion to before materialize_pending_chunks call, extracting from pending_chunks before it's consumed. This way only 1 clone (for cache), and compression uses the original.

description: Populate chunk_data_cache in stage_chunk_if_missing during writes. Consistent improvement: sm_read 19.1ms (-46%), lg_read 18.0ms (-26%). Write phases unchanged (within noise).

asi.hypothesis: Warming chunk_data_cache during writes with raw block data eliminates pack reads + CRC32 + decompression on first read
asi.result: Consistent ~46% sm_read and ~26% lg_read improvement. Write overhead is within noise. Simple change: insert Arc<Vec<u8>> into chunk_data_cache at stage_chunk_if_missing where data is already cloned for pending_chunks.
asi.why_works: The benchmark reads files immediately after writing them. With cache warm, load_extent_payload returns cached data instead of reading from pack files. The data in cache is the exact 1MB block data that would be decompressed on read.

description: Cache warm optimization re-run #3. sm_read=18.6ms (-47%), lg_read=18.0ms (-26%). Consistent across 3 runs. Write phases within noise.

Extent cache (Cache<(ino,block_idx),ExtentRecord>) + fast-path in small file reads to avoid SurrealKV transactions. sm_read=18.2ms, lg_read=18.0ms. No measurable improvement - transaction overhead is tiny for 1-block files. Structural improvement retained for future metadata-heavy workloads.

asi.hypothesis: Caching extents in-memory avoids SurrealKV read transaction overhead for small file reads
asi.result: No measurable change. Per-file read transaction overhead is ~0.01ms, dwarfed by FUSE/IO overhead.
asi.next_action_hint: Try a more impactful optimization: reduce batcher.drain() overhead or reduce allocations in the read path.

description: chunk_meta_cache fast-path in stage_chunk_if_missing (check cache before SurrealKV transaction). sm_read=18.1ms, lg_read=18.1ms. No change for benchmark (unique data, no dedup). Structural improvement for dedup-heavy workloads.

asi.hypothesis: Checking chunk_meta_cache before SurrealKV transaction in stage_chunk_if_missing avoids point-read snapshots for cached chunks
asi.result: No change for benchmark (unique random data, no dedup hits). Structural improvement that helps dedup-heavy workloads.
asi.overall_session: Main win: data cache warm during writes (-46% sm_read, -26% lg_read). Incremental structural improvements: chunk_meta_cache fast-path. Further ideas: extent cache (small file metadata), avoid batcher.drain() on reads, share allocation between pending_chunks and data cache.

description: Lightweight point-read API in SurrealKV (vendor). Added Tree::get_value() that creates temporary snapshot for single key lookup, avoiding full Transaction overhead. MetaStore::get_value() wrapper. Updated stage_chunk_if_missing to use it. sm_read=17.6ms, lg_read=18.1ms - maintained. Reduces memory/CPU overhead for metadata operations.

asi.hypothesis: Lightweight point-read without full Transaction reduces overhead for metadata existence checks
asi.result: Read performance maintained. Structural improvement reduces memory allocation (no Transaction object) and CPU overhead (no write_set/mode checking). Benefits high-throughput metadata-heavy workloads.
asi.vendor_change: Added get_value() to surrealkv Tree and MetaStore

description: Extended lightweight point-read to get_inode() in MetaStore. Uses get_value() instead of read_txn() for inode lookups. sm_read=17.7ms, lg_read=17.3ms maintained. Reduces Transaction overhead for every file operation.

asi.hypothesis: Lightweight point-read for inode lookups reduces Transaction overhead
asi.result: Read performance stable. Each file operation (open/read/getattr) now avoids full Transaction creation for inode lookup. Benefits all workloads with file metadata operations.

description: Extended lightweight point-read to sys key lookups (get_u64_sys, get_sys) in MetaStore. All simple metadata lookups now use get_value() instead of read_txn(). sm_read=18.0ms, lg_read=17.7ms maintained.

asi.hypothesis: Lightweight point-read for all simple metadata lookups
asi.result: Read performance maintained. All simple point-reads in MetaStore now avoid full Transaction creation. Benefits all metadata operations.
asi.vendor_change: Extended get_value() to all MetaStore point-read methods

description: Skip batcher.drain() on reads when no writes happened since last drain. Added AtomicU64 counter (writes_since_last_drain) to FsCore. Read handler checks counter before draining. sm_read=17.8ms, lg_read=18.2ms maintained. Reduces unnecessary async channel handshakes for read-only workloads.

asi.hypothesis: Skipping batcher.drain() on reads when no writes are pending avoids unnecessary channel handshakes
asi.result: Read performance maintained. Correctness: counter is incremented before write enqueue, so any write triggers a drain on subsequent read. FUSE serializes operations at inode level, so TOCTOU race is impossible in practice.

description: Populate chunk_data_cache on dedup hits in stage_chunk_if_missing. When chunk already exists, but block data is available, warm the data cache for future reads. sm_read=17.6ms, lg_read=18.7ms. No change for benchmark (unique data, no dedup). Helps dedup-heavy workloads.

asi.hypothesis: Warming data cache on dedup hits helps when same block data is written multiple times
asi.result: No change for benchmark (unique random data has no dedup). Structural improvement for copy/rsync-like workloads where dedup is common.

description: Persistent file read plan cache keyed by (ino, data_version). Survives across file close/reopen. Checked as fallback after fh-keyed cache miss. sm_read=17.7ms, lg_read=17.4ms. Benefits reopen-heavy workloads.

asi.hypothesis: Caching read plans by (ino, data_version) avoids rebuilding them on file close/reopen
asi.result: No change for benchmark (files opened once). Structural improvement for reopen-heavy workloads like editors, build tools.

description: Replace read_txn with get_value in load_dirent_cached. Change inode_data_versions from tokio::sync::Mutex to parking_lot::Mutex (no .await while locked). sm_read=18.3ms, lg_read=18.6ms. Reduces overhead for directory lookups and version tracking.

asi.hypothesis: Lightweight point-read for dirent lookups + faster mutex for inode data versions
asi.result: Read performance maintained. Correctness: load_dirent_cached now avoids full transaction. inode_data_versions uses parking_lot::Mutex for faster contention handling.

description: Convert file_handles Mutex from tokio::sync to parking_lot::Mutex. All functions using file_handles (register, validate, get/store plan, unregister) now sync. Removes async overhead from every read. sm_read=17.5ms, lg_read=17.8ms.

asi.hypothesis: parking_lot::Mutex is faster than tokio::sync::Mutex for non-async mutex acquisitions
asi.reasoning: file_handles is locked on every read (validate_file_handle), get_small_file_read_plan, and store_small_file_read_plan. None hold the lock across .await. Switched to parking_lot::Mutex and made 5 functions synchronous.
